mapper.sql: id, title, content, status, project_id, agent_id, start_time, execution_period, reject_reason, user_id, create_time, update_time
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO workflow_tasks (title, content, status, project_id, agent_id, start_time, execution_period, reject_reason, user_id) VALUES (#{title}, #{content}, #{status}, #{projectId}, #{agentId}, #{startTime}, #{executionPeriod}, #{rejectReason}, #{userId})
SELECT last_insert_rowid()
mapper.update: UPDATE workflow_tasks SET title = #{title}, content = #{content}, status = #{status}, project_id = #{projectId}, agent_id = #{agentId}, start_time = #{startTime}, execution_period = #{executionPeriod}, reject_reason = #{rejectReason}, user_id = #{userId}, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT t.id, t.title, t.content, t.status, t.project_id, t.agent_id, t.start_time, t.execution_period, t.reject_reason, t.user_id, t.create_time, t.update_time, a.name AS agent_name, p.name AS project_name FROM workflow_tasks t LEFT JOIN agents a ON t.agent_id = a.id LEFT JOIN projects p ON t.project_id = p.id WHERE t.id = #{id}
SELECT FROM workflow_tasks WHERE status IN ('pending_execution', 'rejected') ORDER BY id ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE workflow_tasks SET status = #{status}, reject_reason = #{rejectReason}, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT FROM workflow_tasks WHERE project_id = #{projectId} ORDER BY id DESC
